name: vida-divina-strategy-decision-engine
description: Strategy Decision Engine — Fase 10 del roadmap de negocio. Evalúa StrategyFeedback (learning-strategy-engine/) con reglas determinísticas (sin ML/LLM) y produce StrategyDecision (ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER). No ejecuta ninguna decisión ni modifica Content Strategy/CRM/Meta/WhatsApp -- ACCEPT solo significa READY_FOR_STRATEGY_UPDATE, executionStatus siempre NOT_EXECUTED.
